sections.heading: PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
sections.text: PHP developer with a focus on backend architecture (Laravel and Symfony). I have been building software for over 15 years, first through volunteer open-source and community projects (Narutorpg.de since 2009) and professionally since 2019. My focus is clean, test-driven PHP backends: multi-tenant REST APIs (API Platform, OpenAPI), event-driven real-time synchronization (Mercure/SSE, Redis queues), plus CI/CD and test automation (PHPUnit, Pest, Behat, PHPStan level 9). I like to understand a system end-to-end, measure the results, and keep improving it. I also integrate LLMs into development workflows and am currently learning RAG and vector databases.

sections.heading: SKILLS
lines: Backend: PHP (OOP), Laravel, Laravel Sanctum, Symfony, Filament, Livewire, Laravel Octane, Laravel Horizon (Redis queues), API Platform (REST + OpenAPI), REST APIs, JWT, OAuth, Guzzle, Mercure/SSE, Twig
Frontend: TypeScript, JavaScript, Vue.js, Alpine.js, Tailwind CSS, HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, Vite

Architecture & Quality: Software Architecture, DDD, Event-Driven Architecture, SOLID, Design Patterns, Clean Code, Requirements Engineering, PHPUnit, Pest, Behat/BDD (Gherkin), PHPStan/Larastan (level 9), ECS, Performance Optimization, Security
DevOps: Docker, Docker Compose, DDEV, GitLab CI/CD, Git, Linux, Apache, Composer, npm
Python & Data: Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Pydantic, NumPy, pytest
AI & LLM Engineering: AI-assisted development (Claude Code), Prompt Engineering, OpenAI API, Anthropic API, MCP, AI Agents
Currently learning: RAG, vector databases, embeddings

items.title: PHP / Laravel Developer
bullets: Core contributor (top 3 of a ~7-person team) on an existing greenfield restaurant point-of-sale (POS) platform: a Domain-Driven, package-oriented Laravel 13 monolith (Filament, Livewire) with PostgreSQL and Redis; owning specific components rather than the overall architecture.

Designed and owned end-to-end the platform's external REST API (API Platform on Laravel) with multi-tenant, permission-scoped access control: row-level query extensions, tenant-isolation write guards, Sanctum-based API credentials and permission management, and OpenAPI documentation.

Designed and implemented the real-time pivot-event synchronization mechanism (a custom laravel-pivot-events package plus a dedicated PivotEvents domain, pushed via Mercure/SSE) within an event-driven architecture backed by Redis queues (Laravel Horizon) and Laravel Octane.
Automated tests across the stack: PHPUnit plus full-stack BDD (Behat/Gherkin, Pest, Selenium) and Bruno API collections in a GitLab CI pipeline enforcing PHPStan level 9 (Larastan) and ECS.

Containerized development and CI with Docker Compose (PostgreSQL, Redis, TSE emulator); integrated German fiscal compliance (TSE/KassenSichV, DSFinV-K) and OPI payment terminals; additionally used AI tools in daily development.

items.title: PHP Developer (Application Development)
bullets: Independently planned, built, and maintained custom PHP web applications (ticketing systems, websites, marketing tools) from requirements gathering through to operation.
Translated client requirements into software: wrote user stories with the team and clients, conceived requirements-appropriate custom software, and reviewed and approved programming work.
Designed, set up, and optimized the underlying database systems.
Coordinated and led projects; automated tests with PHPUnit and documented code with PHPDoc; additionally used AI tools for code analysis and automation.

items.title: PHP Developer / Coordination
bullets: Long-term team development of a large, historically-grown PHP browser game (volunteer since 2009, second-most commits); modernizing the codebase toward Symfony and Doctrine ORM (incl. migrations).
Analyzing and refactoring complex legacy structures while preserving the existing architecture; coordinating a ~10-person team.

items.title: Laravel Auth & CSV Import (Sanctum API + session)
bullets: Laravel 11 application demonstrating two authentication approaches: Sanctum token auth for a JSON API and session-based web login; CSV contact import.

Interface-driven service-layer architecture (AuthentificationInterface, FileHandlerInterface -> Sanctum/Session/CSV services), custom middleware, and an Artisan command; progressive refactoring of auth logic out of controllers into services.

items.title: Laravel Pivot Events - custom-IDs feature (open-source contribution)
bullets: Extended an existing open-source Laravel package with support for custom IDs and timestamps on pivot tables; worked within its Eloquent relationship internals (BelongsToMany/MorphToMany, model events).

items.title: WordPress + React/TypeScript Article Plugin
bullets: WordPress plugin that embeds a React/TypeScript SPA via a shortcode and a custom Gutenberg editor button; the SPA fetches articles, users, and categories through the WordPress REST API.
OOP plugin architecture with hooks, dynamic asset registration for hashed Vite builds, and a generic, typed API base component; reproducible local development via DDEV.

items.title: Execution Research & Backtesting Platform
bullets: Designed and built an algorithmic execution and backtesting system in Python on the event-driven execution framework framework, including walk-forward validation and Monte Carlo portfolio simulation.
Built a distributed signal-execution system (FastAPI dashboard, multiple Docker containers, MT 5 integration) with layered risk management and extensive test coverage (pytest).
